source_text: Alienus erat a natura divina sanguinem et carnem suscipere; propter nos ea suscepit ut domesticos nos faceret qui alieni eramus per peccatum.
pass_a_gloss: It was foreign to the divine nature to take up blood and flesh; for us he took them up to make us household members who had become foreign through sin.
pass_b_english: Flesh and blood were alien to his divinity; he took what was not his so that we who were estranged by sin might become his household.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
